title: Certification: Financial Interests and Arrangements of Clinical Investigators
provenance: Official FDA secured PDF provided by the product owner (upload); canonical source: fda.gov forms catalog. Decrypted at onboarding with pikepdf — the committed asset is the decrypted form, and sha256 above is of those bytes. sha256EncryptedOriginal is the as-supplied encrypted file.
note: Official FDA blank form, decrypted at onboarding via scripts/ind-forms/onboard-fda-form.ts (pikepdf) because pdf-lib cannot decrypt AES. Measured on the DECRYPTED asset: STATIC XFA over a real AcroForm layer — /XFA is present but /NeedsRendering is absent, so the page content is real rather than an Adobe shell. pdf-lib drops the XFA packet on load and fills the 14-field AcroForm layer underneath; that is the supported path and this manifest is promoted by readTemplate. Note the top-level /Fields array holds a single XFA subform container (topmostSubform[0]); the 14 is the recursive count of terminal fields carrying /FT, which is what a filler targets. The original is AES-128 (V4/R4); permission bits /P -1036 allow form filling (bit 9).
